name: Your AI Team by AUTOPILOT.OI (5 setups)
description_html:
5 PDF setup kits for your own Claude account (free plan works). Your AI team for the jobs that eat your week: one price, $39. Bought separately: $78.96.

  • Front Desk: drafts price replies, quotes with your deposit rules and follow ups, from your real prices, in your voice.
  • Collector (Invoice Chaser): invoices from job notes and the right reminder for how late each customer is.
  • Reviews (Review Desk): a reply to every review in your voice, plus the text that asks happy customers for a new one.
  • Bookkeeper (Bookkeeping Sorter): upload a bank statement, type sort, every charge lands in a category with monthly totals.
  • Marketer (Content Week): answer 5 questions on Sunday, get 7 posts for the week.

What you get: 5 PDF setup kits. Each one has a setup helper, a worked example and a cheat sheet.

How it works: add a kit to a free Claude Project, paste one message, answer a few easy questions, then type one word. About 15 to 30 minutes per setup, right on your phone.

You need: the Claude app (the free plan works).

It drafts, you send. It does not send messages, post, file taxes or take payments on its own. Not tax, legal or accounting advice. 30 day refund: reply to your receipt.

AUTOPILOT.OI is independent and not affiliated with Anthropic. Claude is a product of Anthropic.
